name: Kirin (Qilin)
description: An auspicious chimerical creature of East Asian mythology — qilin in Chinese, kirin in Japanese, girin in Korean, kỳ lân in Vietnamese — said to appear at the birth or death of a sage or just ruler, and so gentle that it will not tread on living grass or eat living things.

aliases.name: Qilin
aliases.meaning: 麒麟; the original Chinese name

origin: Throughout the East Asian cultural sphere — China, Japan, Korea, Vietnam — and in adjacent traditions of Mongolia, Tibet, and Thailand.
